The '''Seatrooper One blaster speargun''' was a model of [[blaster speargun]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. The Seatrooper One was issued to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[aquatic assault stormtrooper]]s during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ROE" />
